name: Pulsing Blue Shard
summary: Pulsing Blue Shards are rare crystals taken from Ironjaw Basilisks in Stranglethorn Vale. Kin'weelay needs their magic to control the Mind's Eye.

sections.title: A Singing Crystal
sections.body: Kin'weelay, a troll at Grom'gol Base Camp, asks you to bring him Pulsing Blue Shards from Ironjaw Basilisks in Crystalvein Mine. He needs their magic for the Mind's Eye, a jewel said to hold great power.

faq.answer: Pulsing Blue Shards are rare crystals taken from Ironjaw Basilisks in Stranglethorn Vale. Their magic can help Kin'weelay control the Mind's Eye.
Kin'weelay at Grom'gol Base Camp needs Pulsing Blue Shards for his work with the Mind's Eye.

faq.q: Where do the shards come from?
faq.answer: Ironjaw Basilisks in Crystalvein Mine yield Pulsing Blue Shards.
The Mind's Eye is a jewel hidden deep in Stranglethorn Vale, said to hold great power. Kin'weelay believes the shards can help him bend its magic to his will.
Kin'weelay needs the shards' magic to control the Mind's Eye, which he hopes to use to bring Yenniku back from the darkness.
